Preserve her quiet, reserved non-smiling expression and clean delicate anime linework. Right hand extended gently forward at chest height, palm upward, natural five fingers; left hand near heart. Flowing long hair and apron ribbons trail widely to the LEFT in a single gentle wind direction, visible distinct strands, dramatic but controlled. Normal anime illustration proportions, NOT chibi. Character's face centered around x=62%, y=29%; character fits ENTIRELY within frame with generous 6% margins on sides/top, torso ends naturally at bottom. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background with no backdrop, no floor or cast shadow, no drawn checkerboard, no gray/magenta/green background, no scenery, no particles, no halos, no words. This character will be composited over a moving city background; keep transparent spaces between flowing hair locks. Do not change outfit, no wings, no weapon, no smile.
